overview.description: How the business is doing: sales, profit and margin, with a map of margin by state and trends by segment and category. Used to spot the regions and product lines eroding margin before month-end.

customers.description: Which customers are worth the most, and how they cluster by region. Used to find high-value and unprofitable accounts and decide where to invest relationship effort.
customers.audience: Sales and account management, regional leads

shipping.description: How well orders ship: early, on time or late, and where delays cluster by region, ship mode and week, before they turn into customer problems.

commission.description: A what-if model for sales compensation. Change quota, base salary and commission rate to see how each rep's earnings, quota attainment and total pay would shift before committing to a new plan.

product.description: Which products and categories make the money: revenue and profit by product family over time, with per-product detail showing where to invest and what is eroding margin.

performance.description: Are we hitting our numbers: actual sales against target, month by month, by segment and category.
